purpose: Recover prior engineering context from integrity-checked memory, create deterministic dependency-aware task plans, invoke only registered handlers inside scoped authority, and hold task completion until independent evidence is present.

capabilities.name: Integrity-checked engineering memory recovery
acceptance: broken hash links and tampering fail closed
ranked memories retain source revision and record hash
empty retrieval does not fabricate facts

capabilities.name: Dependency-aware task planner
acceptance: missing dependencies and cycles are rejected
missing capabilities or memory references block tasks
repeated inputs produce the same plan digest

capabilities.name: Registered-handler task runner
outputs: plan-only receipt or bounded handler result
acceptance: unknown handlers and missing capabilities are held
arbitrary shell/network execution is not provided

capabilities.name: Independent completion and evidence gate
acceptance: producer cannot independently verify own result
kernel cannot write Ω.000 or self-promote

integration_points: project.genome / Ω0_GENESIS_CORE / Ω.000: read-only authority references
Permanent Engineering Memory (PR #58): append-only PEM schema/ledger adapter boundary
Omega Mind engineering fabric (PR #78): task plan and evidence capsule adapter boundary
Governed specialist orchestration kernel (PR #90): capability/authority/evidence admission boundary
Innovation Operation Index: proposed innovations and evidence-gap input
ARC-X: independent evidence evaluation and separate admission proposal
VCRE: future simulation task adapter after its interface is pinned and tested
known_limits: This module is an in-process deterministic reference implementation, not a distributed task broker.
Memory retrieval is lexical, not semantic/vector retrieval; the full ordered ledger snapshot must be available to verify the chain.
The kernel does not launch remote agents or call Microsoft/cloud providers.
The caller supplies handler implementations; their outputs are not automatically trusted or verified.
External side effects are disabled; sandbox mutation would need an explicit runtime authorization adapter.
The canonical genome and Ω.000 are not modified by this proposal.
